title: Equal sorted values keep the A to Z order as tie-break and an em-dash Margin % sorts as zero
custom_preconds: 1. Two reps have equal values in a sortable column; if producible, one rep shows "—" in Margin % (seed ZZAUTOTEST data).
custom_steps:
1. Sort by the column where the two reps tie and read their relative order.
2. Sort by Margin % ascending and locate the "—" rep.
custom_expected:
1. Reps with equal values in the sorted column retain the default A→Z order between them.
2. A Margin % cell rendered "—" (undefined) sorts as zero.
